description: This Java class acts as a wrapper around the SavingsAccountRepository, providing methods for fetching SavingsAccount entities with additional not-found detection logic, and some utility functions related to SavingsAccounts. It facilitates lazy loading of associations, and handles transaction management for database operations.

classes.name: SavingsAccountRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring service that wraps the SavingsAccountRepository to add additional detection, lazy loading, and transaction handling.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Fetches a SavingsAccount by ID, throws SavingsAccountNotFoundException if not found, and loads lazy collections.

methods.name: findSavingsWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Fetches a SavingsAccount by ID with optional backdated transaction support, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection (overloaded)
methods.description: Fetches a SavingsAccount by ID and DepositAccountType, throws exception if not found, loads lazy collections.

methods.name: findSavingAccountByClientId
methods.description: Retrieves savings accounts associated with a specific client ID, with lazy collection loading.

methods.name: findSavingAccountByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves savings accounts matching a specific status, with lazy collection loading.

methods.name: findByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of savings accounts by status, with lazy loading.

methods.name: findByClientIdAndGroupId
methods.description: Finds savings accounts by client and group IDs.

methods.name: doNonClosedSavingAccountsExistForClient
methods.description: Checks if there are non-closed savings accounts for a client.

methods.name: findByGroupId
methods.description: Finds savings accounts associated with a group ID.

methods.name: findByGsimId
methods.description: Finds savings accounts associated with a GSIM ID.

methods.name: findTransactionsAfterPivotDate
methods.description: Retrieves transactions after a specified date for a savings account.

methods.name: findTransactionRunningBalanceBeforePivotDate
methods.description: Retrieves transaction balances before a date for a savings account.

methods.name: findAllTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions for a savings account.

methods.name: findNonClosedAccountByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds an active (non-closed) savings account by account number.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a savings account entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a savings account entity.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves and immediately flushes the savings account entity.

methods.name: findIdByExternalId
methods.description: Finds the ID of a savings account using an external ID.

methods.name: findAccrualData
methods.description: Retrieves accrual data for a savings account up to a certain date, with specific status and accounting rules.

methods.name: findLoanIdsByStatusId
methods.description: Stub method returning null; likely intended to find associated loan IDs by status.
